resources.string: Off by default. Collect limited private logs and allow key-authenticated USB SSH after pairing and a container restart. Turning off stops SSH within two seconds.

Enable the repair toolbox? Only pair a computer you trust: SSH can access this container and its shared files. Use an Android-authorized USB computer to pair an Ed25519 public key, then restart the container. No password login or network desktop access is enabled. This does not enable Android USB debugging.
Save a local ZIP of limited Android diagnostics. Review before sharing; nothing is uploaded automatically.
Turn Debugging off, forget the paired computer and delete collected Android logs. Games and saved data are kept. Exported copies are not deleted.
